about: Vectors for share-registration/1 (DEC-0086), written by tools/vectors/share-registration.ts, never by hand. grantId: common.schema.json#/$defs/shareGrantId, ok exactly when a share grant id, compared as written. derive: deriveShareRegistrations(record, entries, orgId, previouslyRegistered); a record carries only the members the derivation reads, so a port's derivation must not validate the whole estate record first. intake: decideShareRegistration(held, registration, binding); held is the receiver's list of what it holds per (user, grantId); binding.transport is the verdict of devices.md's transport steps 0 to 8. join: joinGrantUsage(event, binding, registrations); binding is the one recorded for the event's epoch; a receiver keeps one held list per organization. gate: gateGrantUsage(answer), the collector's sender gate over the enrollment's latest answer to the grant's registration; a case without answer is no answer yet. A time with more than three fraction digits is carried at millisecond precision: a withdrawal floored and a window's end rounded down by cutting the fraction, the offset kept; a window's start rounded up, written as Date#toISOString does when it moves. Of several revocations the earliest after the floor wins, the first listed among equals: the record's revocations in order, then the applied entries in order. expected is exactly what the reference returns; a digest is sha256: of the UTF-8 RFC 8785 form of the registration kept. Every case holds in every time zone.
